conventions: Shell basis |a> = phi_{I mu}(r) x |sigma> on atom I: complex Y_lm (Condon-Shortley), m = -l..l, pure spinors, a = sigma*(2l+1) + (m+l), sigma = 0 the first spinor component of the WFN (s_z = +1/2 along Cartesian z of the cell). Tensor Lam[c, a, a2, b, d] = <a(1) a2(2)| Lam^c |b(1) d(2)> over the 2l+1 spatial orbitals only, Lam(1;2) = (r12 x p1)/r12^3, c = x, y, z; stored as lam_re / lam_im = flat lists in C (row-major) order of an array of shape [3, n, n, n, n], n = 2l+1. Hartree atomic units, WITHOUT the alpha^2 prefactor (alpha = 1/137.035999084). Spin-orbital two-body tensor g[p,q,r,s] = -alpha^2 sum_c Lam[c, a_p, a_q, a_r, a_s] delta(sigma_p, sigma_r) (sigma^c/2)[sigma_q, sigma_s] = <p(1) q(2)|g|r(1) s(2)>, H = sum_pqrs g[pqrs] a+_p a+_q a_s a_r. Density matrix D[a,b] = <a|rho|b> = sum_n f_n <a|psi_n><psi_n|b> (QE ns is its transpose). Mean field: d1[p,r] = sum_qs g[p,q,r,s] D[s,q]; d2[p,r] = sum_qs g[q,p,s,r] D[s,q]; x1[p,r] = -sum_qs g[p,q,s,r] D[s,q]; x2[p,r] = -sum_qs g[q,p,r,s] D[s,q]; h_dir = d1 + d2, h_x = x1 + x2 (Ha). I0 = int_0^inf dr2 u(r2)^2 r2^-3 int_0^r2 dr1 u(r1)^2 (Marvin), r3 = <r^-3>, both by grid quadrature of the original normalised radial function u = rR. b1_mev_per_muB = -(alpha^2/2) I0 in meV: l.m coefficient of d1 per unit (N_up - N_dn) of a spherical collinear shell. x_closed_mev = c in x1 + x2 = c l.s for D = identity (meV). projector.chi = r*R(r) on projector.r (bohr), the plain j-average [(l+1) chi_{l+1/2} + l chi_{l-1/2}]/(2l+1) of the UPF PP_CHI functions (psp/hubbard_ops.py::j_averaged_atomic_wfcs), no sign flip, no renormalisation.
